LESSON: MUSICAL RHYMES.

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMANCE
Topic 8.2: Musical Rhymes.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Musical Rhymes.. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What rhyme did you recite?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. display the ability to recite simple rhymes
2. perform simple rhymes for entertainment
3. recite a range of musical rhymes to enhance creativity e) appreciate others talents as they perform simple rhymes rhymes 104 Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. display the ability to recite simple rhymes
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display the ability to recite simple rhymes. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. perform simple rhymes for entertainment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform simple rhymes for entertainment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. recite a range of musical rhymes to enhance creativity e) appreciate others talents as they perform simple rhymes rhymes 104 Core-Competence

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

1. Write five sentences about Musical Rhymes.. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What rhyme did you recite?
